analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lens are 33rd on three points after a 9-1 home defeat by Como, the worst result of the phase, and new coach Yannick Cahuzac (who replaced Dino Toppmöller) has a defence with no clean sheet in 17 Champions League games. Bodø/Glimt are 25th on four points after a 0-0 at home to Lille. Both sides probably need to win to stay in contention for the play-offs. Lens are without Odsonne Edouard, possibly until 2027.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals. I lean slightly higher: Lens have conceded 16 in four games and Bodø scored three in their 4-3 loss to Napoli. The 0-0 with Lille is the warning that Bodø can go quiet.

corners.text: The numbers say 12.2 corners, 8.6 of them for Lens. I lean lower: Lens have been the weaker side in three of their four games, and after a 9-1 defeat their coach may be more careful than the numbers expect. Thauvin, who created the most chances in the first three matchdays, is their main source of them.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. I lean higher: with both teams fighting to stay above 25th, the game should be tense, and a home side trying to restore pride after a 9-1 defeat may play with an edge.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.2 shots, 21.2 of them for Lens. I lean lower: 21 is a lot for a Lens side that has been second-best in three of four European games and has just lost 9-1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.4 shots on target. I lean slightly lower in line with the shots, mainly on Lens's side, as their main striker Edouard is out.
